'''''Saksang''''' or '''''sa-sang''''' is a savory, spicy [[Indonesian cuisine|Indonesian]] dish from the  [[Batak cuisine|Batak people]].<ref name="sum">{{cite web|title=Sa-sang or Saksang|publisher=toursumatra.com|date=October 12, 2010|url=http://toursumatra.com/blogs/380-sa-sang-or-saksang.html|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110831085739/http://toursumatra.com/blogs/380-sa-sang-or-saksang.html|archive-date=August 31, 2011}}</ref> It is made from minced [[pork]] or [[dog meat]]<ref name="jak"/> (or, more rarely, [[Domestic buffalo|water buffalo]] meat) stewed in its blood,<ref name="ind">{{cite web|title =Food|publisher =itravelindonesia.com|url=http://www.itravelindonesia.com/food.aspx}}</ref> coconut milk and spices; including [[kaffir lime]] and [[bay leaf|bay leaves]], [[coriander]], [[shallot]], [[garlic]], [[chili pepper]] and [[Thai pepper]], [[lemongrass]], [[ginger]], [[galangal]], [[turmeric]] and ''[[andaliman]]'' (the fruit of a native shrub similar to [[Sichuan pepper]]).<ref name="jak">{{cite web|title =Food they crave|publisher =The Jakarta Post|date=April 4, 2010|url=http://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2010/04/04/food-they-crave.html}}</ref>

Although ''saksang'' is widely consumed and familiar within [[Batak|Batak tribes]]' traditions, it is more often associated with [[Toba Batak people|Batak Toba]].<ref name="Toba">{{cite web | title = Resep Sangsang atau Saksang Babi khas Batak - traditional pork dish | work = TobaTabo | url = http://www.tobatabo.com/321+resep-sangsang-atau-saksang-babi-khas-batak-traditional-pork-dish.htm}}</ref> Saksang has special significance to the Bataks, as it is an obligatory dish in Batak marriage celebrations.<ref name="berk">{{cite book|author=Ryan Ver Berkmoes|title =Indonesia|publisher =Lonely Planet|year =2010|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=4GMBFsaFNN4C&q=saksang+batak&pg=PA85|isbn=978-1-74104-830-8}}</ref> ''Saksang'', together with ''[[Babi panggang|panggang]]'', ''[[arsik]]'' and ''[[daun ubi tumbuk]]'', are the essential dishes in [[Batak cuisine]].
